item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting Guangdong will moderate in the next couple of days. Daytime temperatures over the region will rise. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas midweek next week. It will be windy and cloudier over the region. The easterly airstream will weaken slightly in the latter part of next week. It will be brighter over Guangdong and mild during the day. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China afterwards.
